# Bitterapple

> Free audio plug-ins and practical iOS/macOS apps by recording engineer Hiroshi Kojima.

## Main pages

- Home: https://bitterapple.github.io/
- Plugins: https://bitterapple.github.io/
- Apps: https://bitterapple.github.io/
- Harmony & Counterpoint: https://bitterapple.github.io/support/harmonycounterpoint/
- ScoreShelf: https://bitterapple.github.io/support/ScoreShelf/

## Products

- Propagation: free IR-inspired algorithmic reverb that turns captured spaces into editable reverb controls.
- Level Range EQ: free dynamic EQ-style plug-in for applying different EQ curves to quiet, mid-level, and loud signal ranges.
- DSPTrace: plug-in analyzer in active development for loading AU/VST processors, sweeping parameters, graphing trace results, and documenting how controls change sound.
- Harmony & Counterpoint: a music theory practice app for composers, arrangers, and producers, with guided exercises and red-pen style review.
- ScoreShelf: free iPad sheet music library for managing PDFs, reading scores, light Apple Pencil markup, bookmarks, practice spots, and practice history.
- Studio Mate: iPad recording-session app that adds timecode markers to PDFs and jumps a DAW to the marked spot.
- PocketCam Viewer: iPhone, iPad, and Mac camera-monitor app using one Apple device as a camera and another as a viewer.
- QuickSearchExt: Safari extension for searching selected text on favorite sites from iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
- CopySkipper: macOS one-way folder sync app for reviewable, repeatable rsync-style copying.
- Calendar Calendar: macOS desktop calendar widget with customizable colors, fonts, and readable month layouts.
- WrisTick: watchOS metronome and tuner with haptics, tap tempo, and pitch reference.
- BandMatrix: free 6-band sidechain dynamics plug-in with compression, expansion, and flexible key routing.
- PanBlur: free spatial enhancer for mono, LCR, and 5.1 sources, adding ASMR-like stereo presence without moving the pan position. Version 1.7.0 adds 5.1 support, with final surround-host verification still pending.
- SourceField: free 2D ASMR-style source placement plug-in for changing mono or stereo position, source direction, and listener direction from an XY field.
- PhaseSlice: free multi-band phase and timing shaper for tightening drums, transients, and frequency-specific timing.
- Dialogue Doctor: free dialogue cleanup plug-in for voice and post-production workflows.
- Spectral Leveler: real-time spectral dynamics plug-in for smoothing harshness without static EQ.
- Distance: free psychoacoustic distance plug-in for pushing close sounds farther back without obvious reverb.
